map.name: Fireball Jump
map.objective: Fireball jump your way to the end of the course.

rules.rule: Right click a fireball at your feet to launch yourself.
Every new island forward is +1 point. Checkpoint every 5 islands.
Fall and you go back to your last checkpoint.
First to the finish ends the match 30 seconds later.
Highest score when time runs out wins.
